content: {"rule":"K-G4","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text assigns answered status to a cited verse, which is the kind of counting status K-G4 governs.","verdict":"CLEAN","quote":"answered in [CR3] LINK 2.","rule_words":"A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count. A verse the judge counts toward a broken link is counted this way. A verse the judge says was answered is not counted.","room":"A verse the judge says was answered is not counted: one reading bars counting it as an unanswered witness, the other would require a quoted pressing sentence; the text expressly says answered.","why":"The judge labels the verse answered, and K-G4 says an answered verse is not counted, so no unanswered-witness counting or quote requirement is triggered."}
